name: What does the step-by-step construction process look like for a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What does the step-by-step construction process look like for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site feasibility assessment to inspect your existing plumbing stacks, main drain lines, and electrical panel capacity. Next comes layout design, material selection, and obtaining required building, plumbing, and electrical permits. Construction starts with framing and rough-in plumbing and electrical, followed by rough inspections. Subflooring, waterproofing, drywall, and ventilation ducting come next. Finally, finish trades install tile, vanity cabinetry, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and trim before scheduling the final municipal code inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves through feasibility assessment, permitting, rough plumbing and electrical, framing, waterproofing, drywall, finish fixture installation, and final inspections.
